verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer runs client-facing platforms that handle client data (GDHQ, Contract Generator, D&O portal, Catalyze), so a no-AI-training privacy guarantee is a fair question. The evidence contains no opt-out, policy, or contractual commitment that client data won't be used to train AI models. The only related item says the internal ChatGD tool for attorneys runs on a 'secure, enterprise instance' of OpenAI via Azure. That describes host-platform infrastructure, not a documented user-facing no-training guarantee or control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
